Different configurations of the same model shall not be accepted u nless specifically approved by the Buyer. 3. Latest/Current Generation 3.1. The offered equipment shall be a current production model and sh all not be an end-of-life/end-of-sale product at the time of bid submission. 3.2. OEM product lifecycle/support declaration shall be furnished.

OEM/authorised service support shall be available in the consignee' s state/region. 5.2. Maximum response time for warranty complaints: 48 hours. 5.3. Maximum resolution time: 07 working days, failing which the item s hall be repaired/replaced as applicable under warranty terms by the sell er 6. Genuine Products 6.1. All products supplied shall be brand-new, unused and genuine OEM products. 6.2. Refurbished, reconditioned, demo or repaired products shall not be accepted. 6.3 Serial numbers/IMEI numbers, as applicable, shall be recorded at th e time of acceptance. 7. Software & Licensing 7.1. All operating systems and bundled software shall be genuine, prope rly licensed and activated. 7.2. No trial, evaluation or unauthorised software shall be supplied. 7.3. OEM-supported drivers and firmware shall be provided.

8. Security Requirements 8.1. Devices shall support secure boot, TPM/security hardware where ap plicable, firmware security updates and OEM security patches. 8.2. Devices shall not contain unauthorised third-party software or hard ware. 8.3. The supplied equipment shall comply with applicable Government o f India cyber-security requirements. 9. Data Protection 9.1. No user data, photographs, documents, contacts or other informati on shall be retained by the vendor/OEM during servicing. 9.2. Any replacement/storage component containing user data shall be handled in accordance with the Buyer's data-security instructions. 10. Inspection & Acceptance 10.1. The Buyer shall have the right to inspect and verify the make, mod el, serial number, configuration and technical specifications before accept ance. 10.2. Any item not conforming to the accepted technical specification m ay be rejected/replaced at the supplier's cost. 11. Product Documentation 11.1. OEM datasheet/brochure clearly establishing compliance with the s pecified t echnical parameters shall be submitted. 11.2. User manuals, warranty documents and relevant technical docume ntation shall be supplied with the equipment. 12. Uniformity of Supply 12.1. Wherever quantities permit, the Buyer may require supply of a sin gle make/model/configuration to ensure standardisation, interoperability,

ease of maintenance and availability of common spares/accessories. 13. Accessories 13.1. All standard OEM accessories required for normal operation shall b e supplied along with the equipment. 13.2. Accessories shall be genuine OEM accessories or OEM-approved ac cessories. 14. Price & Taxes 14.1. The quoted price shall be inclusive of all applicable duties, taxes, fr eight, insurance, installation/configuration and delivery charges, unless sp ecifically stated otherwise in the BOQ. 15. No Substitution 15.1. No change in make/model/configuration shall be made after place ment of order without prior written approval of the Buyer. 16. OEM Support 16.1. The bidder shall provide an OEM-backed escalation matrix, including contact detail 17. Miscellaneous 17.1 It is mandatory for a supplier with minimum 3 years of experience and should have provided similar items to Defence Organization in the pa st. Copy of last supply order to be uploaded without fail. 17.2 Buyer will have the right to cancel the bid at any point of time if th e seller does not respond to concerns of the buyer, even after delivery of t he said items. 17.3 It would be the responsibility of the seller to provide the items at t he duty station without chaging freight/ delivery charges. .
